title: Optimize Assistant: suggestion dashboard with diff replayer and audit timeline
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build an interactive Optimize workspace for surfaced batching and caching suggestions that lets users preview exact config diffs, simulate/ replay the diff against a request sample, and view a tamper-proof apply history and audit timeline. Goal is to reduce unit cost for customers while providing safe rollouts, clear reasoning for suggestions, and full traceability for compliance teams.
acceptance_criteria: Recommendation cards render per-route and per-model with expected savings estimate and confidence band
Clicking ‘Preview diff’ opens a side panel showing a line-by-line JSON config diff against the current runtime config with highlighted tokens and an explanation of each change
‘Replay diff’ runs a sandboxed simulation on a captured representative request set and shows token-level latency and cost delta (no production traffic incurred)
Apply flow requires two-step confirmation with canary % and automatic fallback policy and records a complete audit entry with user, timestamps, and effective config hashes
Audit timeline is immutable and exportable (CSV/JSON) and links to GH PRs, Confluence rationale, and the evaluation snapshot used for simulation
UX is responsive on desktop and tablet; follow WCAG AA color contrast for diff highlights
Telemetry events emitted for preview, simulate, apply, rollback and included in console usage analytics
notes: 2026-02-12: Initial write-up and scoping. Proposed combining diff preview + sandbox replay to increase confidence before apply.
2026-02-18: Eng spike (ENG-4312) validated sandbox replay can run on a scaled-down dedicated pool without touching production KV caches.
2026-02-25: UX crit with Design. Decision: show both absolute and normalized savings and surface a brief human-readable rationale for each recommendation (source: model profiling + rule engine).
2026-03-03: Legal requested immutable audit entries include config hash and user SSO identifier; added export requirement.
2026-03-07: Proto PR opened (console/pull/2486). Feedback from runtime: need opt-in flag for heavy simulations to limit infra cost; added canary-only simulation option.
2026-03-10: PM review — moving to In Progress. Next: finalize telemetry schema, finish Figma flows, and schedule integration tests for apply/rollback path.
implementation_strategy: Phase 1: Recommendation cards + Preview-only with static diffs. Phase 2: Sandbox replay + telemetry. Phase 3: Apply flow with canary rollout and enforced audit logging. Rollback will be automatic on SLO breach and manual via UI with recorded justification.
rollout_plan: Beta to 10 pilot orgs for 2 weeks with feature flag. Monitor cost delta and latency regressions via /optimize/telemetry dashboard. Require opt-in for orgs with compliance label 'on-prem'.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Simulation workload could spike infra costs - Mitigation: run simulations on low-priority dedicated pool and add quota per-org
Risk: Users misapply aggressive batching - Mitigation: enforce conservative default canary % and provide revert button with one-click rollback
Risk: Audit tampering - Mitigation: sign audit entries with service key and include config hash; exportable snapshots stored in append-only location
